scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.
It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation:
这块岩石含有未确认矿石。
无法开采超过上限的数量。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 没有抓到任何东西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 鱼在水里游动。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
你携带的物品过多。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Outsider?
Outsiders have been coming more frequently.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
外来者？
最近外来者越来越常来了。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
It seems like our superiors have permitted your entrance, so I won't stop you either.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
看来上级已经允许你进入了，那我也不会阻拦你。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
My name is Arc.
By the way, hmm... Can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我的名字是阿克。
顺便问一下，嗯...你能听懂我在说什么吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Shake my head
scripts.translation: 摇头

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Did you just say 'Yes'?
Can't believe we understand eachother!
When did you learn our language?
What is your race called?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？你刚才说“是”吗？
真不敢相信我们能互相理解！
你是什么时候学会我们语言的？
你们种族叫什么名字？

scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示戒指，并解释了事情经过，包括我是如何来到这里的... -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
So...hmm, That's how it is...
The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
原来如此...嗯，事情是这样的...
那个巨大的冲击和神秘的爆炸的源头...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Quite an interesting story.
That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真是有趣的故事。
原来你们人类一直在到处探索...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
现在我很清楚，你不是马努克巨人派来的。
谢谢你告诉我这些有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Oh? Is that so?
We use different languages as expected...
That's a bit frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
哦？是吗？
果然我们使用的语言不同...
这有点令人沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
By the way, you...
No, never mind...
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
顺便问一下，你...
不，算了...
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, right. {0}!
That's a strange pronunciation.
I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，对了。{0}！
这个发音有点奇怪。
我可能会读错，请多包涵...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
总之，我有件事想拜托你。可以吗？

scripts.text: What favor?
scripts.translation: 什么忙？

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 现在不行

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Um...Ah..It's...
A little...complicated...
- Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克环顾四周，确认附近没有别人后，满意地点点头，压低声音继续说。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
老实说，我很担心我的一个朋友。她未经许可就离开了，说要去查看你们的营地。从那以后她就一直没回来。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
但是，我不能离开岗位去找她，因为我有职责守卫存放在这里的实验数据。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她未经许可就离开了，我甚至没法向上级报告...那只会让事情变得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
想到这些我就很担心...
事实上，我们正在尽量避免与马努克的巨人接触，所以我们各自远离对方的领地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你们的营地位于我们两个种族之间的中立地带...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果她靠近他们的领地，可能已经去了雪原...
那样我们就更难找到她了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
马努克巨人可能会把这当成挑衅...不是吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，你是想让我去找你的朋友，对吧？
局势这么复杂，你自己没法离开岗位去找她？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Exactly!
You're quite observant.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
没错！
你很敏锐。

scripts.text: Sure, I will do it.
scripts.translation: 当然，我会去做的

scripts.text: Sorry, can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，帮不了你

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，如果我要去找她，我需要更多的信息。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
不用担心...^4d4dff泰拉^000000习惯用打结的植物标记去过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She does it so that she won't get lost.
If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她这样做是为了防止迷路。
如果你发现一串打结的植物，顺着它们应该就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
Please, I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
虽然找起来可能很困难，但总比什么都不做强...
拜托了，求求你了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，还有，请对其他拉菲尼保密。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...
Please, find her.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
记住，{0}...这件事要保密...
拜托了，请找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It sure was an unreasonable favor...
You too were sent here to carry on a mission...
That was thoughtless of me...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
这确实是个过分的要求...
你也是被派来执行任务的...
是我考虑不周了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Is that so? Of course.
You were sent here to carry on your own mission...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
是吗？当然。
你也是被派来执行自己的任务的...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
^4d4dff泰拉^000000有个习惯，会用植物打结来标记目的地。
寻找她时请留意这一点。另外，不要告诉其他拉菲尼她失踪的事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Do me this favor please.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}，你是唯一能帮我的人...
请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Did you find anything?
Have you found any knotted plants?
Yeah, that's the mark
that Terra leaves.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你找到什么了吗？
有没有发现打结的植物？
对，那就是泰拉留下的标记。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Keep it up and find her
for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
继续找下去，替我找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, Well met!
What do I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，你来了！
我现在该怎么办？！

scripts.text: What? What happened?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？发生什么事了？

scripts.text: - Arc looks like he was thrown into confusion about something. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克看起来陷入了某种困惑之中。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra came back!!!
but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉回来了！！！
但是她浑身是伤...

scripts.text: Covered with wounds?
scripts.translation: 浑身是伤？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She didn't even get treatment!
She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她甚至没接受治疗！
就拖着疲惫的身体把布拉迪姆带走了！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
It happened all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
连理由都没告诉我！
我明明拒绝了，但她不听我的！
事情发生得太突然了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!
What shoud I do now?
What do I have to do?
Terra left again and she was hurt...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！
我现在该怎么办？
我该怎么做？
泰拉又离开了，而且她受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
而我只是站在这里...什么也没做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.
scripts.translation: 你有强烈的责任感

scripts.text:
[Arc]
......anyways.
I couldn't either stop her, or follow her...
What now...?
Why did she take the Bradium...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
...总之。
我既没能拦住她，也没能跟上她...
现在该怎么办...？
她为什么要拿走布拉迪姆...？

scripts.text: - You tell Arc about the Giant from the cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你把洞穴里那名巨人的事告诉了阿克。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Is that what happened?
Bradium...is certainly a precious ore for Sapha.
They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？原来如此？
布拉迪姆确实是萨法珍视的矿石。
他们会使用精炼过的布拉迪姆...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You said that a Sapha was hurt?
And its body was already stiff?
Impossible!
Terra!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你说有个萨法受伤了？
而且身体已经僵硬了？
不可能！
泰拉！

scripts.text: - Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克突然开始收拾装备。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你发现那名萨法的洞穴在哪里？
我们巡查周边时，根本没有这样的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation: 你想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Can't you see?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你还不明白吗？
我要出去找泰拉。她带走了布拉迪姆，这肯定和那名萨法有关。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
scripts.translation: 你擅离职守没关系吗？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It's.. ...
...No....
Shit, then what should I do!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
这... ...
...不行...
该死，我现在该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去吧。只有我知道那个洞穴的确切位置。
我会去把她带回来。
如果泰拉去了那个洞穴，我应该能找到她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们先听泰拉把事情说完吧。
你得留在这里守卫，对吧？
如果泰拉真的未经许可就拿走了布拉迪姆...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
上级不会坐视不管的...
抱歉麻烦你了，但是...
请去把她带回来...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
...Please, find Terra.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真的很抱歉把你卷进这堆麻烦里...
...请找到泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？萨法的村庄里有一只受伤的拉菲尼？
是泰拉吗？！她被那些萨法混蛋抓住了吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。我无法确切确认被抓住的拉菲尼是谁。
而且他们似乎没有伤害拉菲尼的意图。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，他们在寻找能治疗受伤拉菲尼的东西...
如果我们给他们带些药，也许就有机会看到那只拉菲尼是谁。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白你有多着急...但这是我唯一能想到的确认她身份的办法。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会带些疗伤药过去。如果被抓的拉菲尼是泰拉，我就把她带回来。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
..........
OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
...
好吧，看来这是目前我们能做的最好的事了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
Especially for us Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你知道世界树吗？
没有什么比世界树果实更适合治疗伤口了...
尤其对我们拉菲尼而言...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
.Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果你有世界树果实，就可以用它治疗那位拉菲尼...
世界树是生命之树...它的根系与世间万物相连。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I have...
...only three Yggdrasilberries...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我这里有...
...只有三枚世界树浆果...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I will give you these but they won't be enough...
Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我把这些给你，但数量还不够...
外面有一棵巨树...世界树的根在那里露出地面....应该就在那附近。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
有时能在那附近找到世界树果实。
再去找几颗带上。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
这片区域边缘的沼泽附近有一根巨大的树根。
生命之树的根就在那儿露出地面。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你应该能在那里找到一些世界树浆果。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You will need at least 6~7 of them...
.... .. I hope she is safe..
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
至少需要6到7颗...
.... .. 希望她平安..

scripts.text:
[Arc]
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
Terra... please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
采到浆果后，立刻把它们带到萨法村！！！
泰拉...一定要平安。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
...Oh where is Terra...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
...泰拉在哪里...？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!!
Terra's back!!!
She is back in one piece!
...She hasn't been saying a single word since her return, I told her to rest in Yai...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！！
泰拉回来了！！！
她平安无事地回来了！
...她回来后一直一言不发，我让她去雅伊休息了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Please come by if you don't mind...
Terra's Yai.
Which is her Private Residence... It's located at the Southeast direction from here.
I would like to hear a detailed account of what happened.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
方便的话，请过来一趟...
泰拉的雅伊（她的私人住处）在这里的东南方。
我想听听事情的详细经过。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What happened....while she was gone?
I would like to hear a detailed account fn what happened...
Please go to Terra's Yai later.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她离开期间...到底发生了什么？
我想听听事情的详细经过...
请稍后去泰拉的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I really appreciate what you've done for us.
But, I'm worried about Terra.
I hope she can be her old self...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我非常感激你为我们所做的一切。
但我担心泰拉。
希望她能恢复从前的样子...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah~Ah~Stop right there...
This area is off-limits to unauthorized personnel.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊~啊~站住...
此区域禁止未经授权的人员进入。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?

scripts.text: - I can't understand what he's saying... Oh god how frustrating. -
scripts.translation: - 我听不懂他在说什么...天哪，真让人沮丧。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!

scripts.text: - We don't seem to understand eachother. -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都听不懂对方的话。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Halt.
This area is restricted unless you have been given permission.
Especially to outsiders like you.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
站住。
除非获得许可，否则禁止进入此区域。
尤其是像你这样的外来者。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...

scripts.text: - Looks like we don't understand each other. This could be troublesome... -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都听不懂对方的话。这下麻烦了... -

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing toward the^4d4dff Southern^000000 direction.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片朝向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
This is a marking Terra left to remember the way back home.
A knotted leaf is pointing^4d4dff South^000000.
scripts.translation:
这是泰拉留下的标记，用来记住回家的路。
打结的叶片指向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff East^000000.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片指向^4d4dff东方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff North^000000.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片指向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
There are footprints here as well as signs that someone has fallen.
It looks like someone was fighting here?
But who?
scripts.translation:
这里有脚印，还有有人摔倒的痕迹。
看起来有人在这里战斗过？
但是是谁呢？

scripts.text: There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Someone must have had a fight here.
There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation:
有人一定在这里战斗过。
有脚印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 这里的脚印似乎通向某个地方。

scripts.text:
There's evidence that there was a fight here too.
These footsteps can't be a Laphine's...
scripts.translation:
这里也有战斗过的证据。
这些脚印不像是拉菲尼留下的...

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff巨树的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff巨树的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 这里的脚印似乎通向某个地方。

scripts.text:
There's a stem entangled inside an opening in the roots of a huge tree...
It looks like something slipped here.
scripts.translation:
巨树根部的缝隙里缠着一根茎蔓...
看起来有什么东西从这里滑了下去。

scripts.text: A cold breeze is blowing out from deep inside the tree.
scripts.translation: 一股冷风从树的深处吹出来。

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追踪痕迹

scripts.text: Looks dangerous... head back.
scripts.translation: 看起来很危险... 回去吧

scripts.text: You take a one step forward carefully through the muddy roots and slip.
scripts.translation: 你小心地穿过泥泞的树根，却一脚滑倒。

scripts.text:
It's too dark to see anything inside...but it feels like there's a big hole at the bottom.
I'd better step back...It looks dangerous.
scripts.translation:
里面太黑，什么也看不见...但感觉底下有个大洞。
还是退后吧...看起来很危险。

scripts.text: Between huge roots, there is a hole leads to the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 巨大的树根之间有个洞口，通往地下洞穴。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text: I'm not going in there.
scripts.translation: 我不进去

scripts.text: Again, you slip through the muddy roots.
scripts.translation: 你又一次在泥泞的树根间滑倒了。

scripts.text: You decide to come back later.
scripts.translation: 你决定稍后再来。

scripts.text:
Strange looking stems are entangled inside an opening of huge roots.
Surface looks unstable...I should step away before I slip on it.
scripts.translation:
巨大的树根缝隙里缠着形状奇怪的茎蔓。
表面很滑...我最好离远点，免得摔倒。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
你携带的物品过多。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text: This is the only spot where sunlight is shining down through a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 这是唯一有阳光透过天花板洞口照射进来的地方。

scripts.text: Looking up I see the roots of the tree and stems digging up a mud-plastered wall, so the sunlight could shine through....2.j...There is a statue of Giant on the ground.
scripts.translation: 抬头望去，树根和茎蔓穿透了覆泥的墙壁，让阳光照了进来...2.j...地上有一尊巨人雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A statue in a place like this...
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这种地方居然有一尊雕像...
真有意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm, This resembles... that giant tribe in Manuk...
Huh? It's wearing a muffler...
...It can't be!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这看起来像...马努克的巨人部族...
咦？它戴着围巾...
...不会吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot of scars on it... as if it had been in a severe fight...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它身上有很多伤疤...看起来经历过一场恶战...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And it appears like it's holding something in its arms...
Just what happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它似乎还抱着什么东西...
这里到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't imagine what happened here, but I don't see Terra's marks anymore...
and this cave looks unsafe... I'd better go back to Arc for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道这里发生了什么，但已经看不到泰拉留下的标记了...
洞穴看起来也不安全...我先回去找阿克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could it be... Terra was fighting this Giant?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难道...泰拉和这个巨人战斗过？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways... How do I get out of here?
That hole I came in is too slippery to climb back out...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管怎样...我怎么出去？
进来的洞太滑了，爬不上去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Light is coming in from the ceiling above... Maybe I should just climb a stem around here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
上方天花板的洞口透进了光...也许可以沿着附近的茎蔓爬上去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm done with this place.
I should go back to Arc...
Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受够这里了。
得回去找阿克...
先找出口吧。

scripts.text:
I came back here, but there's no trace of Terra...
There's only one thing different from the last time..Small particles of an ore are sprinkled around the Sapha's dead body.
scripts.translation:
我又回到这里，却没看见泰拉的踪迹...

scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
她们只想用这种作为我们生命之源的矿石做饰品。
凡是有魔力的东西，她们都收集。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should calm down a bit... Tell me about that captured Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你先冷静一点...告诉我那个被抓的拉菲尼的事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Right, I'm sorry.
Anyways, shortly after Ogen went missing the fairy appears... this is too suspicious...
and that fairy was severely wounded too.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
好吧，抱歉。
总之，奥根失踪后不久，那个妖精就出现了...实在可疑...
而且她伤得很重。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I think...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我想...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
That fairy attacked Ogen as he was trying to peek on your camp.
And she was drawn by Ogen's bradium and came all the way here to find more bradium!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我想...
那个妖精在奥根窥探你们营地时袭击了他。
她被奥根的布拉迪姆吸引，一路来到这里寻找更多布拉迪姆！

scripts.text: That could be right...
scripts.translation: 也许是这样...

scripts.text: I don't see it that way...
scripts.translation: 我不这么认为...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But does that Ore called bradium really possess an overwhelming magical power?
It didn't seem like that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是，那种叫布拉迪姆的矿石真有那么强的魔力吗？
看起来不像...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
This war with the Laphine... is to protect the bradium from them...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
真的吗？可我们萨法人离不开布拉迪姆。
这场与拉菲尼的战争...就是为了保护布拉迪姆不被她们夺走...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see...
Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...
你们两族正在为布拉迪姆而战...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is... Is that so?
Then how do you see this situation?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
是...是这样吗？
那你如何看待这种局势？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just occurred to me...
It's like some kind of forbidden area...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚想到...
这像是某种禁区...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyhow, You are going to ask that fairy about Ogen, right?
If that's the case, I could interpret between you two...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，你打算问那个妖精奥根的事，对吧？
如果是这样，我可以帮你们翻译...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah?!
Then just wait here for a sec!
I will go and ask Luik about this!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
是吗？！
那你在这儿等一下！
我去问问卢伊克！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh, Ah~!
This is a prison.
You need to obey the rules to keep a peaceful group life.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
呃，啊~！
这里是监狱。
为了维持群体生活的秩序，你得遵守规则。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This is where people who break the rules are kept overnight.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
这里是关押违反规则的人过夜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Oh. I'm not one of them.
I just have some business here.
Snorren is a good Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
哦，我不是囚犯。
我只是来办点事。
斯诺伦是个好萨法人。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Umm.. Hold on a sec...
Luik. It's me. Snorren.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
嗯...等一下...
卢伊克，是我，斯诺伦。

scripts.text:
[Voice through the door]
Ah, I told you it's not possible Snorren!
I can only put you in a cell for one night!
scripts.translation:
[门后传来的声音]
啊，我说过不行，斯诺伦！
我只能让你在牢房里待一晚！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yikes-! Luik, It's not that!
I brought someone who would interpret that fairy's words!
till, Can't I come in?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
哎呀！卢伊克，不是那回事！
我带了个能翻译妖精语言的人来！
那么，我能进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Shut up! Anyway, we have more things to worry about. This Laphine, we need to treat her wounds...
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克的声音]
闭嘴！总之，我们还有更多事要担心。这个拉菲尼得先治伤...

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克的声音]
她的身体和我们完全不同。该怎么办？
嘿，斯诺伦！给我拿点东西来，什么草药之类的！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Herbs? Is her condition that bad?
Can't we fix her with bradium?
Oh right, She's not Sapha, ey?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
草药？她情况这么严重吗？
不能用布拉迪姆治疗吗？
哦对，她不是萨法，对吧？

scripts.text: Nothing gets past you...
scripts.translation: 什么都瞒不过你...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Do you have anything on your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你有什么心事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's a Laphine, right? Then we should ask a Laphine about it...
Like what we need to treat her...
I can take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她是拉菲尼，对吧？那我们该问问拉菲尼族人怎么治疗她...
比如需要什么药。
我来想办法。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really?
Then hurry up and bring something back...
We will wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
真的吗？
那就快点带点东西回来...
我们会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I think I have no choice but to go back and ask Arc....)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（看来我只能回去问阿克了...）

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Hurry up and go find a way to cure this Laphine...
Then Luik might let us in.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
快点想办法治好这个拉菲尼...
那样卢伊克可能就会让我们进去了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Did you find a cure?
This.. is one strange looking fruit.
I saw this fruit from time to time, but never thought this would be a cure..?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你找到疗法了吗？
这...看起来是种奇怪的水果。
我偶尔见过它，没想到竟能治病...？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I will take everything you've brought with you!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我会收下你带来的所有东西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Now, Let's go inside!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
现在，我们进去吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...this won't be enough....
I would need at least 6~7 of these...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...这些还不够...
我至少还需要6到7颗...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Ah, I think we would need more than what I've brought here... I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？哦，我带来的可能不够...我再去拿。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I already told Luik everything about you...
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我已经把关于你的一切告诉卢伊克了...
我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I've been waiting for you...
Let's make haste.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我一直在等你...
我们快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I'm really confused now...Should I believe your story or not.
If it is true that cave really exists and Ogen is hurt...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我现在很困惑...该不该相信你的话。
如果那个洞穴真的存在，而且奥根受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
The approximate location is...
Huge Roots of a tree. Got it.
You go ahead first. I will stop by at a refinery and be right after you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
大概位置是...
巨大的树根。明白了。
你先过去，我去趟精炼厂，随后就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Since that place is Laphine's territory, I will go quitely so they won't notice me.
You just go on ahead, I will be right behind you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
那里是拉菲尼的领地，我会悄悄过去，免得被发现。
你先走，我马上跟上。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
You are back. .. Luik wanted me to tell you this...
Terra, that Laphine, is free now.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你回来了...卢伊克让我告诉你...
那个拉菲尼泰拉，现在已经自由了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
We are tired of fighting. We didn't even want to start...
And we saw her true intention before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我们厌倦了战斗，甚至一开始就不想打...
而且我们看到了她的真实意图。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Go and check if Terra went back to her home safely...
Ogen... He went back to Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
去看看泰拉是否平安回家...
奥根...他回归了大自然。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I really don't think what Ogen did was the right thing to do...
But that was... Ogen...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我真不觉得奥根做得对...
但那就是...奥根...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Forgive me, I'm a bit depressed...
I'd rather just rest here.
I really appreciate what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
请原谅，我有点消沉...
我只想在这里休息一下。
非常感谢你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Come back anytime...
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
随时欢迎你回来...
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
What do you think of this muffler?
This belonged to Ogen...
Does it look good on me?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你觉得这条围巾怎么样？
这是奥根的...
我戴着好看吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Outsiders shouldn't be here without permission.
Please get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
外人没有许可不能来这里。
请离开。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.

scripts.text: The doors are locked... I can't get in.
scripts.translation: 门锁住了...我进不去。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
你携带的物品过多。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷不醒。
我看到有绷带在止血...
看来是卢伊克做的。

scripts.text:
Luik and Snorren did everything to extract juice out of a Yggdrasilberry
chopped and stuffed it into a mouth and paste them on the body...
scripts.translation: 卢伊克和斯诺伦把世界树果实切开、榨汁，再把汁液灌进她嘴里、涂在她身上...

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Finally she's coming to.
Ok, {0}, it's up to you now.
And you better not fake any of the words she's saying.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她终于醒了。
好了，{0}，接下来交给你。
你可别篡改她说的话。

scripts.text: - I nod to Luik and began talking to the Laphine. -
scripts.translation: - 我向卢伊克点头示意，开始与拉菲尼交谈。 -

scripts.text: - After the Laphine gained her full consciousness, she gazed around and spoke in shaky voice. -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼完全清醒后，环顾四周，用颤抖的声音说道。 -

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Where... am I?
Oh My! That's right! I need Bradium!
Get me out of here!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
我...在哪里？
天哪！对了！我需要布拉迪姆！
快放我出去！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
If I don't go back to him quickly, he... he is going to die!!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
如果我不快点回去找他，他...他会死的！！

scripts.text: Who is HE?
scripts.translation: 他是谁？

scripts.text: Is your name Terra?
scripts.translation: 你叫泰拉吗？

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
一个巨人...洞穴里的巨人...
他...他为了保护我受伤了...
他动不了了！
身体正在变冷。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
我们本是敌人...
但他救了我...
我听说他们需要布拉迪姆才能活下去！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
给我一些布拉迪姆，快！
我不能迟到！

scripts.text: You are Terra. Right?
scripts.translation: 你是泰拉，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎么知道我的名字？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Arc asked me to find you. So I came here.
By the way.. You were saying about a giant, do you mean a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿克让我来找你，所以我就来了。
顺便问一下，你说的巨人是萨法吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴里的萨法...
我到那里时，他已经石化了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.
And that the Bradium is what prevents them from becoming petrified.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
巨人...据说萨法一族受到诅咒，会逐渐石化。
布拉迪姆能阻止他们石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我想给他带一块布拉迪姆...
可是他...呜...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因伤口的剧痛而痛苦不堪，无法继续说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她为什么突然崩溃了？她说了什么？
告诉我她说了什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎么知道我的名字？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came looking for you on behalf of Arc.
Just how did you end up here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受阿克之托来找你的。
你究竟是怎么落到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
To find a... Bra.. dium.
That's right. Bradium! Give me a bradium!!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
去找...布...布拉迪姆。
没错，布拉迪姆！给我一块布拉迪姆！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
一个巨人...洞穴里的巨人...
他...他为了保护我受伤了...
他动不了了！
身体正在变冷。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
我们本是敌人...
但他救了我...
我听说他们需要布拉迪姆才能活下去！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
给我一些布拉迪姆，快！
我不能迟到！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴里的萨法...
我赶到那里时，他的身体已经石化了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.
And that the Bradium is what prevents them from becoming petrified.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
巨人...据说萨法一族被诅咒会石化。
而布拉迪姆可以防止他们石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我试着给他带了一块布拉迪姆... ...
但是他...呜...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因伤口的剧痛而痛苦不堪，无法继续说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她为什么突然崩溃了？她说了什么？
告诉我她说了什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Let that Fairy rest for a while, now tell me what you were talking about.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
让那个妖精先休息一会儿，现在告诉我你们刚才在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She's just too exhausted and fell asleep...
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她只是太累睡着了...
别打扰她。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She can leave any time she likes.
It feels so dry in here.
Oh well, that's normal.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她想走随时都可以走。
这里感觉好干燥。
算了，这很正常。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷了。
我看见有人用绷带止血...
看来是卢伊克做的。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Ier er ee ras d?
Ye ada sd?
Nffd..?
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
Ier er ee ras d?
Ye ada sd?
Nffd...?

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
...Riveh...AshIman Or mah...
..ah..Thor..ThorOsa Yee Lu..ung...
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
...Riveh...AshIman Or mah...
...ah...Thor...ThorOsa Yee Lu...ung...

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
你携带的物品过多。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Here, Luik. He said this is a cure for Laphine.
Should we just let her eat it as it is?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
给你，卢伊克。他说这是治疗拉菲尼的药。
要直接让她吃下去吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh.. and your name was..?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
呃...还有，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah, Right.
{0}, you should try talking to that Laphine...
Let's hear her story.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
没错，就是这样。
{0}，你应该试着和那个拉菲尼对话...
听听她的故事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Please help me translater.
We'll be watching as you speak to her.
Right, Luik?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
请帮我翻译。
我们会在旁边看着你和她谈话。
对吧，卢伊克？

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Maybe.
Let's ask her what happened, before it is too late.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
也许吧。
趁还来得及，先问问她发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Let's listen to her story.
Why don't we start from... Why does she want a bradium?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
听听她怎么说吧。
先问问...她为什么需要布拉迪姆？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This part must be told to Luik in exact detail.
scripts.translation:

地上有一种水果。

这是一棵世界树！

[{0}]

Let's go back to Snorren.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿克给了我三颗世界树果实，而且...
我找到了...三颗。加起来应该有六颗了。
我们去找斯诺伦吧。

scripts.text: I've already pulled out a Yggdradsil... but is there anyting else..?
scripts.translation: 我已经摘出了一颗世界树果实...但还有其他东西吗...？

scripts.text:
I've been bitten by an unknown insect.
It hurts!
scripts.translation:
我被一只不知名的昆虫咬了。
好痛！

scripts.text:
A huge fruit is here.
I don't know what kind of fruit it is.
scripts.translation:
这里有一个巨大的水果。
我不知道这是什么水果。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Hello.
You're a human right?
My name is Strom.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
你好。
你是人类吧？
我叫斯特罗姆。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
But, you guys seem so weak.
You don't have solid skin nor enough power.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
但是，你们看起来好弱。
你们既没有坚硬的皮肤，也没有足够的力量。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
How did you guys get here?
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
你们是怎么来到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Your language seems gentle, but it seems like you are here to create more tension.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
你们的语言听起来很温和，但你们似乎是来加剧紧张局势的。

scripts.text: Keep the peace.
scripts.translation: 保持和平

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, we humans are smaller than you... but...
we have been training ourselves to be strong.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我们人类比你们小...但是...
我们一直在训练自己变得更强。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now let me show you that
we can match your strength!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在让我证明，
我们的力量也能与你们匹敌！

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Anyway...
Some bad things happened to my one of my colleagues in that cave you found recently.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
总之...
最近你们发现的那个洞穴里，我有位同伴遭遇了不测。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
There're monsters called ^4d4dffRata^000000 and ^4d4dffDueyrr^000000.
If you terminate them, I would regard you as a decent and strong person.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
那里有两种魔物，叫^4d4dff拉塔^000000和^4d4dff杜内尔^000000。
如果你消灭它们，我就承认你是个可靠又强大的人。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
...is that it?
Let me think.
Since you have so much confidence in their abilities...
I will find you a worthy challenge to prove it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
...就这些？
让我想想。
既然你这么有信心...
我会给你安排一场值得的挑战，证明你的本事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, but human beings can be stronger when they all work together.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，但人类在团结合作时可以变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Sure enough... I, the Sapha Galtun, Strom, apologize to you. I should not have been so quick to despise you.
I admit that you are a brave soldier, please feel free to visit Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
确实如此...我，萨法·加尔图恩族的斯特罗姆，向你道歉。我不该这么快就轻视你。
我承认你是勇敢的战士，欢迎随时来马努克做客。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Although I don't have much to offer, please accept these coins.
If you need to buy something, you can use them.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
虽然我没有太多可以提供的，但请收下这些硬币。
如果需要买东西，可以用它们。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
If you want to show you're so strong...
Please find and defeat the Rata and Duneyrr in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
如果你想证明自己的实力...
请去洞穴里找到并击败拉塔和杜内尔。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
Here icy climate is not suitable for biological survival, but we do not feel cold,
so we're not very concerned about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
这里的严寒不利于生物生存，但我们感觉不到冷，所以不太在意。

scripts.text:
[Strom]
But... you're different.
In such cold weather, you are best to don Hillslions fur...
scripts.translation:
[斯特罗姆]
不过...你们不同。
这么冷的天气，最好穿上希斯利安的皮毛...

We've got more than enough for now though.

谢谢你帮我收集浓缩布拉迪姆，帮了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
Thank you for collecting the Enriched Bradium for me, it was very helpful.
I hope you can help me again.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
谢谢你为我收集了浓缩布拉迪姆，这非常有帮助。
希望以后还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]

On behalf of the Sapha, I extend our thanks to you.
I hope you can help us again.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
太好了，这些够用了。
我代表萨法向你致谢。
希望以后还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
What's up?
You're not prepared yet.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
怎么了？
你还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
Hello.
This is where we refine stones.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
你好。
这里是矿石精炼场。

scripts.text: About collecting stones.
scripts.translation: 关于收集石头

scripts.text: About the usage of stones.
scripts.translation: 关于石头的使用

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
To prevent our bodies from becoming numb, we need Bradium.
From the Bradium we can extract a special element that we need to survive.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
为了避免身体麻痹，我们需要布拉迪姆。
我们可以从布拉迪姆中提取生存所需的特殊成分。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
The mining industry is primary here since our lives depend on it.
But the mine has become clogged.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
这里的采矿业至关重要，因为我们的生命依赖布拉迪姆。
但矿道已经堵塞了。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
I've already heard that you guys are good soldiers.
Would you mind terminating the Bradium Golem, and bringing back some Bradium for me?
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
我听说你们都是出色的战士。
能否消灭布拉迪姆石魔，并给我带些布拉迪姆回来？

scripts.text: Sure, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 当然，我不介意

scripts.text: Nope, I can't.
scripts.translation: 不行，我做不到

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
Then take this mission.
Please hunt Bradium Golem and bring me 20 blended Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
那就接下任务吧。
请猎杀布拉迪姆石魔，并带回20块混合布拉迪姆。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
Oh, this is our fate.
How could I be so naive to depend on others?
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
哦，这就是我们的命运。
我怎么这么天真，竟然依赖别人？

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
We refine Bradium and extract special things from it.
Then form that into an injection.
When it is refined it is used to maintain our body cycles.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
我们精炼布拉迪姆，从中提取特殊成分，再制成注射剂。
精炼后的布拉迪姆用来维持我们的身体机能。

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
That's why we are quite advanced in this industry.
Other industries are also well developed... but...
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
因此我们在这一行业上相当先进。
其他行业也发展得很好...但是...

scripts.text:
[Manuk Engineer]
This is our top priority because it is crucial for our survival.
scripts.translation:
[马努克工程师]
这是我们的首要任务，因为它对我们的生存至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Thank you for collecting those items for me.
That should be sufficient for the time being.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
谢谢你为我收集这些材料。
暂时应该够用了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Thank you for collecting those items for me.
Hopefully you can help us again.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
谢谢你为我收集这些材料。
希望以后还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Oh, fantastic.
These are enough materials for today.
I'll let you know if I need more.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
哦，太好了。
今天的材料已经足够了。
如果还需要，我会通知你的。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
What can I help you with?
Not yet done with my request?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
有什么可以帮你的吗？
我的请求还没完成吗？

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
What's up??
I need to make more decorations for the Yai.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
怎么了？
我得继续给雅伊制作装饰品。

scripts.text: May I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: What's a Yai?
scripts.translation: 什么是雅伊？

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
You want to help?
This place is being used for battle but it is also our home.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
你想帮忙吗？
这里虽然被用作战场，但也是我们生活的家园。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
We prefer to be alone so we must each have our own Yai.
Though we are in a military base we should take care of each Yai.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
我们喜欢独处，因此每个人都需要自己的雅伊。
即使住在军事基地里，也要照料好自己的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
I am not a soldier but we hope all of us to be as confident as they are.
I would like to support all Laphine with my skills.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
我不是士兵，但希望我们都能像他们一样自信。
我想用自己的手艺支持所有拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
So I want to help make decorations for everyone's Yai.
I need more materials to make them.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
所以我想帮忙为每个人的雅伊制作装饰品。
我需要更多的材料来制作它们。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
I heard that a water ghost has been appearing in the cave.
Can you bring me 15 Crystallized Teardrop and 15 Fluorescent Liquid?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
我听说洞穴里出现了一只水鬼。
你能给我带15个结晶泪滴和15瓶荧光色的液体吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Please take my request.
Can you bring me 15 Crystallized Teardrop and 15 Fluorescent Liquid?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
请接受我的请求。
你能给我带15个结晶泪滴和15瓶荧光色的液体吗？

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Yes, I'm sure that you have your own business to attend to.
I feel embarrassed asking a favor from you, as a Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
是的，我相信你有自己的事情要忙。
作为一个拉菲尼，向你提出这样的请求让我感到有些尴尬。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
But, why are you trying to be involved in our business yet you won't take up our request?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
但是，你为什么要介入我们的事务，却又不接受我们的请求呢？

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Yai...
All grown Laphine have one.
They're essential for all Laphine to live in since we are very private people.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
雅伊...
所有成年拉菲尼都有自己的雅伊。
我们十分重视隐私，所以雅伊是生活必需的。

scripts.text: It's a house...?
scripts.translation: 那是房子...？

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Yes...
That's it. We sometimes invite our friends or guests to our Yai.
And decorations for Yai are quite important to us...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
是的...
就是这样。我们有时会邀请朋友或客人来我们的雅伊。
雅伊的装饰品对我们来说非常重要...

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
We Laphine care about ourselves and our Yai as well.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
我们拉菲尼也很关心自己，还有我们的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
We are far away from our hometown now...
If we don't have this kind of hobby, there's nothing to enjoy here.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
我们现在离家乡很远了...
如果没有这种爱好，在这里就没什么乐趣了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine craftsman]
Hm? Oh, can't you see I'm busy?
I'm making ornaments though, if you must know.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼工匠]
嗯？哦，你没看到我正忙着吗？
我在做装饰品，如果你非要问的话。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Why isn't it working, Taab?
That should be working.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
为什么不行啊，塔布？
那样应该可以行的。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
That's very dangerous. Do you want to die..?!
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
那太危险了。你想死吗...？！

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Are you ignoring cute pets??
We've been able to get Pickys and even Zealotus!
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
你是在无视可爱的宠物吗？！
我们已经能驯养小鸡，甚至泽洛图斯了！

scripts.text:
[Taab]
No way, even if you ask me...
Hillslion is very adorable...
But you can't.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
没门，就算你求我...
希斯利安看起来很可爱...
但你不能养。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Then let me know why you object to this.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
那你告诉我，你为什么反对这件事。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
It's too dangerous. I've trained monsters before.
Hillslions look cute and adorable, but it's not very realistic.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
这太危险了。我以前训练过魔物。
希斯利安看起来可爱，但现实中根本不适合当宠物。

scripts.text:
[Taab]
Can't you see that?
I've tried to train them... but I couldn't.
How can we can train them as a cute pet...?
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你看不出来吗？
我试着训练过它们... 但失败了。
我们怎么能把它们当成可爱的宠物来训练...？

scripts.text:
[Taab]
It would definitely try to escape from us...
Then he would become very awful.
I don't agree with this.
scripts.translation:
[塔布]
你没看出来吗？
我试过训练它们...但做不到。
我们怎么可能把它们训练成可爱的宠物...？

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Nah...
Can't we control them with magical power?
We've done it before......
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
唔...
不能用魔力控制它们吗？
以前不是成功过吗...

scripts.text: - They just continue to argue -
scripts.translation: - 他们继续争论着 -

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Ah, Taab isn't flexible at all.
Hey there! What's up??
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
唉，塔布一点都不灵活。
嘿，你好啊！怎么了？

scripts.text: Notice for criminal report
scripts.translation: 犯罪报告通知

scripts.text: Cute pet investigation.
scripts.translation: 可爱宠物调查

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Have you hunted the Runaway Dandelion?
Ok, I accept you.
Here's something Rin was storing here.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
你猎杀过逃跑的蒲公英吗？
好，我接受你的委托。
这是琳恩寄存在这里的东西。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
This is Rin's cherished treasure box...
This is enough payment, right?
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
这是琳恩珍藏的宝箱...
用它当报酬够了吧？

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
I know you haven't terminated the Runaway Dandelion yet.
Don't take me for a fool.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
我知道你还没有消灭逃跑的蒲公英。
别把我当傻子。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
I will forward everything to Rin.
She'll love it.
Just tell her your name {0}.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
我会把东西都转交给琳恩。
她会很高兴的。
告诉她你叫{0}就行。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
I can remember that I've heard about you from Rin.
But Rin likes you, so that must mean that you're nice.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
我记得琳恩提过你。
既然她喜欢你，你一定是个好人。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Seaching for a criminal?
I'm not sure that you're involved in it.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
你在找罪犯？
我不确定你是否参与了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Oh! Nice!
I can go through this study deeper with your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
哦！太好了！
有了你的协助，我可以更深入地研究这项课题。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
I will try to make these Dragon eggs into cute pets.
Don't expect much!
Come back after a day to check on the progress.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
我会试着把这些龙蛋变成可爱的宠物。
别抱太大期望！
一天后再回来看看进度吧。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Draco was being kept in the nest just before hatching. Please collect 10 Dragon eggs for me.
You know, those are hard to hatch in captivity.
scripts.translation:
[派恩德尔]
飞龙孵化前会待在巢里。请帮我收集10枚龙蛋。
你知道的，这些龙蛋在人工环境中很难孵化。

scripts.text:
[Pinedel]
Those eggs are about to hatch now.
I will investigate those back home.

scripts.translation:

看起来你携带的东西太多了。
为什么不把一些物品存入仓库，然后再回来呢？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你知道古代睿智之王戒指吗？戴上后就能和动物交谈。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't know if it is a legend based on truth or not... but something like that would come in pretty handy.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
我不知道这是否是基于事实的传说...但如果有那样的东西，会非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Outside of the Expedition Camp, There's a race of animals which uses a mysterious language not used in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
在远征营地外，有一群使用米德加尔特未使用过的神秘语言的动物。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
We don't know if they are friend or foe, but it will be much easier for our research here if we could find out.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
我们不知道它们是敌是友，但如果能弄清楚这一点，我们在这里的研究会顺利得多。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

^0000ff阿鲁纳菲兹语学家^000000应该在联盟总部二楼。

scripts.translation:

去远征营地中央的大楼，到楼里找^0000ff阿鲁纳菲兹语学家^000000，问问他的进度。

scripts.translation:

^0000ff阿鲁纳菲兹语言学家^000000应该在联盟总部二楼。

scripts.translation: - 他正愁眉苦脸地看着堆积如山的研究报告。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Ah, You are here.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
啊，你来了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
t seems like you've done much for us. I thank you for that.
But...Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
看来你为我们做了很多事，谢谢你。
不过...唉...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Can you see this? The amount of these research documents?
It is a good thing that we finally decoded the other world's language... it's just too much.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
你看这些研究资料，数量多得惊人。
终于译出了异世界的语言是好事...就是资料太多了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
We can't always accompany a Linguist for an interpretion... We need to communicate with those other world races in order to explore this world...
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
我们不能总让语学家陪着翻译...要探索这个世界，就得和异世界的种族交流...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
To store this amount of information will need a super computer the size of this headquarter building and its processing speed will be very very slow.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
要存下这么多资料，需要一台和总部大楼一样大的超级计算机，而且处理速度还会很慢。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh... Anyways, If there's any way to store an enormous amount of data, I should be able to make a very-small portable translator.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
唉...总之，要是能找到储存海量资料的方法，我就能做出一台很小的便携翻译器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I heard that by using a Magical Spell of Rune-Midgarts, you can transpose data to a magical power and lock it into a gem... I'd like some suggestions from the Rune-Midgarts Magician.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
我听说可以用卢恩·米德加兹王国的魔法把资料转化为魔力，封存在宝石里...我想听听王国魔法师的建议。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Would you be kind to ask them for help?
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
你能去问问他们，请他们帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
While you are gone, I be here organizing these documents.
scripts.translation:

在你离开的这段时间，我会留在这里整理这些文件。

Would you be kind to ask them for help?

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

在你离开的这段时间，我会留在这里整理这些文件。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
How'd it go?
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
进展如何？

scripts.text: Give him the Gem.
scripts.translation: 给他宝石

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Ah, Looks like you've succeeded.
Inputting data into a gem with a magical power... It's something you can't do with a technology... It's a bit resentful to admit, but it's magnificent.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
啊，看来你办成了。
把资料输入蕴含魔力的宝石...这是科技办不到的事...虽然不太甘心承认，但真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well then, I should be working on making a machine to read the magical data in this Gem so we could use them right away.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
那么，我得制造一台能读取宝石中魔法资料的机器，这样我们就能马上使用了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Fortunately, It won't be as hard as we thought.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
嗯...
幸好，这不会像我们想象的那么难。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
If we transform a magical power wave to an eletric signal and connect it to a human body, then transmit a data to a brain directly. That will allow us to receive and understand a data without any loading process.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
如果把魔力波转换成电信号并连接到人体，再把资料直接传进大脑，就能无需加载过程，直接接收和理解资料。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
I don't have time to explain everything. I have to start the work right away.
With all preperation done, allow me about one hour to finish this thing.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
我没有时间解释所有细节。我必须立刻开始工作。
在一切准备就绪后，请给我大约一个小时来完成这件事。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Sigh, What should I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
唉，我现在该怎么办？！

出什么事了？！

我该怎么办？！难道我不是个天才吗？！

I've made it!!!
scripts.translation:

我成功了！！！

scripts.text:

Convenient portable size!
Fashionable and practical design!
Features the Other World's Words / Idiom / Grammer / Phrases!!
scripts.translation:

便携小巧！
时尚实用！
收录异世界的词汇、成语、语法和短语！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Have you experienced the loading speed?
Don't you even mention it if you haven't.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
你体验过加载速度了吗？
如果你没体验过，就别提了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
That's not all!
For the Well-Being life, it will buff your strength and intelligence!!!!
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
还不止如此！
为了健康，它还能提升力量和智力！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
With all these marvelous features, it's just 39,900 zeny....!!!
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
这么多神奇功能，只要39,900 Zeny...！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Just what are you trying to imitate...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...你这是在模仿什么...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Important thing is, I've made it!!
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
重要的是，我把它做出来了！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Well, Seeing is believing.
Take a look.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
好吧，眼见为实。
请过目。

scripts.text: - He handed over the small ring. -
scripts.translation: - 他递过来一枚小戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
The name is 'the Ring of Wise King'. I designed it after the Ring used by ancient king to communicate with animals.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
它叫“睿智之王戒指”。我参考了古代国王用来和动物交流的戒指设计它。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Do not just look at it like any other rings. You see this small gem here? This socket which holds a gem and a ring part are precisely crafted, it will transform a magical power wave to electric signal and trasmit it directly to our brain.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
别把它当普通戒指。看到这颗小宝石了吗？镶嵌宝石的座和戒指本体都经过精密设计，能把魔力波转换成电信号，直接传入大脑。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Since this electric signal is same as the signal used by our body's nerve system, it will enable us to understand and use the language fluently.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
这种电信号和人体神经系统使用的信号相同，因此戴上它就能流利地理解和使用语言。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Once this translator gets popularized, it'd be just a matter of time for us to advance into the other world. Well, the problem is...we don't have enough quantity yet...
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师多兰斯]
这种翻译器一旦普及，我们进入异世界只是时间问题。问题是...目前数量还不够...

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Hmm...
Anyways, now we've got the idea, I will give you this first piece of work.
scripts.translation:
[机械工程师 多兰斯]
嗯...
总之，既然我们已经有了这个想法，我就把这个初版作品给你吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanic Engineer Dorance]
Thank you for helping us out.
I hope this ring would be a big help for your journey through the other world.
scripts.translation:

谢谢你的帮助。
希望这枚戒指能对你在异世界的旅程大有帮助。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Linguist Dictionary]
Language distinguishes humans from animals. Every single intellectual life form has their own language.
scripts.translation:
[语学家字典]
语言是人类区别于动物的特征。每一种智慧生命都有自己的语言。

scripts.text:

Language is a method / system which delievers one's feeling or thinking by voice or letters. Anyway, its purpose is to communicate.
scripts.translation:
[语学家字典]
语言是一套通过声音或文字表达情感和思想的系统。总之，它的目的是交流。

Difference between a language and a sound is that language is a socially implied promise by making common system of communication to make it possible to understand eachother.

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, it seems like my skin is becoming really dry.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近我的皮肤好像特别干燥。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
看起来你携带了太多物品。
为什么不把一些物品存入仓库，然后再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I do not have any need of your help right now.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
萨法的未来就托付给你了。
眼下我不需要你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, someone who came from Schwarzwald gave me a small mineral as a gift from his home town when he saw our study of Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近有人从修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德来，看到我们研究布拉迪姆，就送了块家乡的小矿石给我。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Oh! Yes, that's it!
This much will be enough!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
哦！是的，就是这个！
这些足够了！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
萨法的未来掌握在你手中。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I don't know if it's caused by the cold weather or our chronic disease getting worse.
It hasn't been too long since we administered the Bradium, so why.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我不知道这是天气寒冷造成的，还是我们的慢性病加重了。
我们才刚注射过布拉迪姆，怎么会这样？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Huu... You see, we are afraid of such things... What a hard life.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
呼...你看，我们害怕这样的事情...真是艰难的生活。

scripts.text: A chronic disease?
scripts.translation: 慢性病？

scripts.text: Bradium?
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
We Sapha, who are descendants of Hwergelmir, survived and rebuilt the Giant tribe in the flood of the blood of Ymir.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我们萨法是赫瓦格密尔的后裔，在依美乐之血的洪流中幸存，并重建了巨人部族。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
For no apparent reason, we developed a chronic disease that makes our bodies dry and harden over time just like an old tree.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
不知为何，我们患上一种慢性病，身体会像老树一样逐渐干燥、硬化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I think that this is the curse of Ymir who bled by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我想这是被众神放血的依美乐施下的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But we couldn't just wait for death to slowly creep up on us and exterminate our entire race.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
但我们不能坐以待毙，任由死亡逼近并灭绝整个族群。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
To heal this rare disease the smartest Sapha studied and studied.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
为了治愈这种罕见疾病，萨法中最聪明的族人进行了反复的研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
What they found was that by injecting a refined Bradium, which is buried around Jotunheim, it can postpone the progression of the disease.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
他们发现，注射约顿海姆周边开采的精炼布拉迪姆，可以延缓病情恶化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
So all of the giants of Sapha established their towns around mines to get Bradium easier.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
因此，萨法巨人都在矿脉周围建立城镇，以便更容易取得布拉迪姆。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It seems the amount of buried Bradium is enough.
But for the eternal prosperity of our tribe, and to make the vaccine for this incurable disease, we have to study more and more.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
目前埋藏的布拉迪姆似乎还够用。
但为了族群长久繁荣，也为了研制治疗这种不治之症的疫苗，我们必须继续深入研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Bradium is the stem of our life.
But the buried Bradium will be exhausted someday, so we Scientists have to find an alternative for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
布拉迪姆是我们的生命之源。
但埋藏的布拉迪姆终有一天会耗尽，所以我们科学家必须为后代找到替代品。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, we've learned that there are various minerals in the human world Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近，我们得知人类世界米德加尔特拥有各种各样的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Now the world called Midgard is
like a holy place for us,
which can bring the wind of
revolution for us.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
如今，米德加尔特对我们而言宛如圣地，能为我们带来变革的契机。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Contact with Midgard
must be the lead of Hwergelmir
for us, the Sapha which has such
a closed-off society.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
对于我们这样封闭的萨法社会而言，与米德加尔特接触一定是赫瓦格密尔的指引。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll draw a result that can
satisfy his lead!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我一定要取得符合这份指引的成果！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I can't say for sure until now,
but this mineral seems to have
many interesting features.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
目前我还无法确定，但这种矿石似乎具有许多有趣的特性。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
As I examine this mineral
more and more, it's really
different from the one in Jotunheim.
This mineral must be helpful
to make a new vaccine!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
越研究这种矿石，我越发现它和约顿海姆的矿石截然不同。
这种矿石一定能帮助我们研制新疫苗！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But the amount of the mineral
is too little to make a
preparation for the
examination.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
但矿石太少，还不够用于前期检验。

scripts.text:

You said you're from Midgard, right? Do you think you can bring me a little bit more of that mineral..
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
你说你来自米德加尔特，对吧？能不能再帮我弄些那种矿石...

scripts.text:

Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?

[格勒努伊]
看起来你带的东西太多了。
先把一些物品存进仓库再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I've heard that some strangers from Midgard are around here, it must be you.
I'm Grenouille, a scientist.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我听说有些米德加尔特来的外乡人在这附近，想必就是你们。
我是科学家格勒努伊。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It's been a long time since
the Laphine built the Splendide camp here
and confronted each other.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
拉菲尼在这里建立辉煌领域营地、与敌人对峙，已经很久了。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
A number of soldiers who
left their hometown Alfheim are
restraining them with fighting against
the harsh cold of Jotunheim
for the holy duty and the faith to
stop the evil attempts to
sickening Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
许多离开故乡阿尔弗雷姆的士兵，为了履行神圣职责、阻止邪恶势力侵害世界树，在约顿海姆的严寒中奋战。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
They're well trained soldiers,
and their captains hold them in high esteem,
so they're enjoying a
comfortable life there.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
他们训练有素，深受长官器重，因此在那里生活得很安逸。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
But there's a saying that
constant dripping water
wears away the stone.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
但俗话说，水滴石穿。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Continuous small battles without big progression
makes the soldiers in Splendide exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
长期只有小规模战斗，又毫无进展，令辉煌领域的士兵们疲惫不堪。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
One day, someone began to sing
a song of Alfheim, that spread rapidly...
Now they strongly
miss their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有一天，有人唱起阿尔弗雷姆的歌，很快传遍了营地...
如今士兵们非常思念故乡。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I was so worried about them and
I finally found a way to
save them from the deep sadness.
I hope you to help me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我很担心他们，终于想到了让他们摆脱悲伤的办法。
希望你能帮我。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There's a Laphine General
who is called Flowery,
in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
辉煌领域有位拉菲尼将军，人称花儿。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
She is a collecting maniac,
so her house is always
in a mess with miscellaneous
things. Flowery must have
seeds from the flowers
of Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
她是收藏狂，房间里总是乱糟糟的。花儿一定收藏着阿尔弗雷姆花朵的种子。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I'll make the flower of
Alfheim open with the seed.
The flower of their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我会用种子培育出阿尔弗雷姆之花。
那是他们故乡的花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There are some devices that purify
the environment and have a function
that can hasten the growth of plants.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有些装置能净化环境，还能加快植物生长。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Please bring me the flower of Alfheim that bloomed by the device.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
请带给我那朵由装置催开的阿尔弗雷姆之花。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
The flower of Alfheim is not
strong enough to keep it's life by
depending on the Splendide device,
but ^FF0000the way^000000 can fill
Splendide by it's scent like it never falls!
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
阿尔弗雷姆之花无法只靠辉煌领域的装置维持生命，不过^FF0000这种方法^000000能让它的香气弥漫整个辉煌领域，仿佛永不凋谢！

scripts.text:

Get a seed from Flowery,
and then use a Purifier
to make the seed blossom.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
从花儿那里拿到种子，再用净化器让种子开花。

scripts.text:

most common kinds of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]

Common flowers like this can bring the familiarity of home back to the soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
哈哈，别担心。这样的普通花朵也能让士兵找回熟悉的家乡气息。
